name: Finance - Finance Overview Dashboard
description: Metabase dashboard tổng quan tài chính: doanh thu, chi phí, lợi nhuận

native.query: SELECT SUM(amount) as total FROM fin_transactions WHERE tenant_id = {{tenant_id}} AND type = 'INCOME' AND created_at >= date_trunc('month', NOW()) AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT SUM(amount) as total FROM fin_transactions WHERE tenant_id = {{tenant_id}} AND type = 'EXPENSE' AND created_at >= date_trunc('month', NOW()) AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT date_trunc('month', created_at) as month, type, SUM(amount) as amount FROM fin_transactions WHERE tenant_id = {{tenant_id}} AND created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '12 months' AND deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY month, type ORDER BY month

SELECT category, SUM(amount) as total FROM fin_expense_requests WHERE tenant_id = {{tenant_id}} AND status = 'APPROVED' AND created_at >= date_trunc('month', NOW()) AND deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY category ORDER BY total DESC

cards.name: Yêu cầu chi phí đang chờ duyệt

native.query: SELECT id, requester_id, amount, currency, category, description, created_at FROM fin_expense_requests WHERE tenant_id = {{tenant_id}} AND status = 'PENDING' AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY created_at DESC
